title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, bump actions & deps, improve cache/parallelism
description:
Motivation:
We have grown many slightly different CI workflows across the monorepo that are hard to maintain and reason about. Several workflows pin old action versions and duplicate caching logic which increases flakiness and maintenance cost. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows, bumps commonly used GitHub Actions, consolidates caching strategy, and removes a few legacy job permutations.

What this PR does (single continuous description):
- Consolidates .github/workflows/lint-*.yml and test-*.yml into two primary workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml.
- Reworks build matrix to use a shared reusable workflow for node versions and target matrices to reduce duplication.
- Bumps actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4 and replaces deprecated uses of actions/upload-artifact with official artifact actions where appropriate.
- Standardizes Node.js matrix to support 18 and 20, removes node 16 entries used only by legacy packages.
- Consolidates cache keys and improves restore/save patterns to reduce cold-cache misses; adds compression setting and explicit cache paths for node_modules, pnpm store and repository-level build caches.
- Adds parallelism control to heavy test jobs and splits integration tests into an optional workflow triggered by labels (ci/integration) to reduce default CI time.
- Removes duplicated release automation jobs across release/*.yml and centralizes release step into .github/workflows/release.yml with improved gating and dry-run support.
- Updates internal CI scripts (scripts/ci/{run-tests.sh,setup-node.sh}) to be idempotent and to emit structured logging for traceability.
- Minor dependency bumps for devDeps referenced in CI (eslint, mocha, typescript) to address linting warnings and flaky test helpers.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate workflows
- [x] Bump GH Action versions
- [x] Improve cache keys and parallelism
- [x] Keep opt-in integration test flow
- [x] Smoke test on redwood repo using ref/test-workflow CI run

Notes on risk and rollout:
- This is mostly CI and dev-only changes (no production code changes) but several packages had devDep bumps; they are limited to lint/test tooling.
- Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI runs for 48 hours; if regressions occur we can revert to previous workflows with a single revert PR.

Related linear items: ENG-2483, ENG-2510; see also older hygiene tickets ENG-1999.
